The thing is that you can also visit the GP for free and they refer you to a specialist. So they are the primary doctor.

My aunt is doing better thank you.  They had to search in the basement of the old hospital I think ( that is still there next to the new hospital) so it was all on paper and it took a while before they had it. I actually think it took almost 2 days🤣🤣
